Concept Font Symbols
q-shuffle Hopf algebra calligraphic \mathcal{H}_q — convolution algebra of \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) under \ast_q; carries the grouplikes \exp_q, \log_q, \mathrm{Li}_2^q. Never plain H_q.
Goncharov period filtration calligraphic \mathcal{P}_n — weight-n periods in the Goncharov motivic filtration ([Kontsevich–Zagier, Goncharov]). Used in conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence. Distinct from P_\ell (elementary symmetric polynomials in JM elements, prop:jucys-murphy-central-elements-qou).
Primitive root of unity Greek + sub \zeta_n := e^{2\pi i / n} — primitive n-th root of unity. Always with subscript: \zeta_5 for Bring S_5-symmetry shape, \zeta_6 = e^{i\pi/3} for figure-8 ideal-tetrahedron shape. Never bare \zeta (collides with Riemann zeta \zeta(s) — always parenthesised — and with character \chi_\zeta — always with \chi prefix).
Vortex morphism Greek \varrho \colon \mathbf{1} \to A — generic closed vortex. Never \gamma for a vortex; \gamma is reserved (photon, Euler–Mascheroni constant, Dirac matrices).
Hahn–Exton q-Bessel italic + sub/super J_\nu^{(3)}(x;q) — matrix coefficient of the quantum motion group E_q(2) (the \mathrm{SU}_q(2)\to E_q(2) contraction); its power-series coefficients are the c_k precision ladder (prop:q-beta-c-k-recursion-from-habiro-q-difference). Subscript \nu = order; never bare J — collides with the Jones polynomial J_K(q) (subscript a knot K). The bar-graded Jacobi–Anger weights are ordinary Bessel J_n(x) (integer order).
q-Lommel polynomial italic h_{n,\nu}(x;q) — degree-n polynomial from iterating the q-Bessel order contiguity J_{\nu+1}=b_\nu J_\nu - J_{\nu-1}; its (algebraic) zeros are the truncated q-Bessel zeros (the "tower from two seeds"). Distinct from the hook-length H_q(\lambda) and the heat-decay rate \mu_\lambda.
